description: This Java class represents a JWT (JSON Web Token) message used within a streaming gateway service, encapsulating a token string and a connection correlation ID.

classes.name: Jwt
classes.description: A final class representing a JWT message with token string and connection correlation ID, implementing StreamControlMessage.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new Jwt instance from a token string and connection correlation ID.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object based on correlation ID and token string.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code based on correlation ID and token string.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the token.
